trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops automatically. No multiplayer or DLC is needed — this is the last trophy you will earn, after A Long Road and the final cleanup.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and it unlocks right after.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 1 by completing the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 2 by completing the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 3 by completing the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 4 by completing its final main mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: complete the final mission of the game and it pops at the credits. There is no mission replay, so there is nothing to redo — just finish the story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, unlocked after the story). The checklist is forgiving — closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 100 optional missions, 300 stunts, plus all robberies, bank vaults, drone races, shooting ranges and Bret's quests. Nothing toward 100% is missable; everything is doable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridges runs are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts; the 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going after this pops.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which types you have done; you will do most of them naturally while chasing the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting range locations. The golds are not too difficult, and the ranges also level up your Focus, which you need for Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 drone race locations (42 drone races in total). You must win at each location, not just race there; all 42 races are also needed for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations around Leonida — car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races. Race locations are marked on the map; winning the same race twice does not count twice.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing location west of Key Lento (purple icon on the map). Go there and beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish all of its levels once. Four video games exist: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat all its extra challenges.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline: in Chapter 3 Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Complete her 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline, marked automatically in Chapter 1 (green KR icon, Key Lento) after Island Dreams. Dive for his treasures at 7 shipwrecks — use the metal detector on the ocean floor — and bring them back to his shop. Kenton goes quiet in later chapters but returns while playing as Jason in Chapter 2-3 (or call Brian to hurry him). Track under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline, marked after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break at Thrillbilly Mudclub, Kelly County. Complete his 5 jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler), Hometown Heroes. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count. Confirmed counting strands: Kirk (Skunk Ape: Skunk Apeology 101, tree effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street race, Bumper to Bumper, race against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile quests and deliveries). Track via the trophy tracker; more strands are still being discovered.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List: unlocked in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and get the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars (list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; green RK icon, west Vice City). Deliver each in good condition for more pay; the cars are often parked in east Vice City and Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only: after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy the labs (quest Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone gives you Spin On This — shut the labs down for good. Available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating as both Lucia and Jason at a spot counts +2 (track under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations). THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It is not marked as a Meditation Spot and it is still unclear whether it is required for the trophy, so do it while you can. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together (after Chapter 2: Coffee Break). For 100% you only need 15 of 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason-only: after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts Jason (Lummox County) to start Veteran Hunted. Hunt the animals he requests and bring them back as Jason; he gives you the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable at any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). There are 15 Target Decks to complete for 100%. Which exact animal unlocks the trophy is still being confirmed — work through his requests and it will pop.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets (18 sets exist across Leonida). Cards are a collectible type scattered around the map — follow a card-set guide to the sets you want and finish any 3 of them.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK-scan 100 locations: hold Up + R1 on anything scannable. There are far more than 100 (31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and more), so scan whatever you pass while exploring.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges (Progress > Challenges). For 100% you need 70 of 80, so this pops on the way; pick the easiest ones first and save the hardest for last.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2: Coffee Break (when you can free-roam together), call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone. Easiest: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops and the helicopter struggle to follow on the tracks. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies give 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2: Coffee Break, with your partner called in, rob 3 shops back-to-back while keeping your wanted level (stay in the flashing red/blue search, not the red heat zone). The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop; if it doesn't, hit a 4th. Good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) — rob items in each and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up, look at a vehicle, hold R1 to scan). Scanning is enough — you don't need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; 200 of the 277 base models are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way. Track under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar). Buff focus first with food, drinks, a shower, and Adrenaline (hold L1 + Triangle) to stretch the time. Line up 5 enemies — gang-operation criminals work; it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — and drop them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Focus levels up via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — the ones sitting on the airfield don't count. Easiest: the plane at terminals E3/E4; drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away. The unlock is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs first — it unlocks the Snap Gun (silent lockpick) and jewelry store robberies (green icons). Break into a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun (don't kick the door — that triggers the alarm), find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave. Good spot: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it teaches bank vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner (hold Right to hand off a bag). Afterward, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans (do his Payday Loans quests first). Rob any 5 vaults for this trophy; all 8 are needed for 100%. Vaults give an instant 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to lose the heat. Up to $205,000 per bank.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Unlocked by the same Chapter 4 mission, That's Where The Money Is…: robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Or do it earlier — block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. Fastest in a plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map becomes visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs (39 operations total; yellow icons when nearby). Track under Progress > Gangs. All 39 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED 20 Nov 2026: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar above Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar — the trophy pops as you drink with the view in front of you.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED 20 Nov 2026: steal the blue Bravado Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City — but only after you have the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Clone the key, drive forward straight through the showroom window and keep going down the street; the pop is slightly delayed. Only this blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling alley in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation) of all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs — buy them at an Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You don't need all 3 in one visit: the robbery icon respawns and you can come back for what you missed, so it is not missable. It is also part of the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength, heart icon). Only possible after Chapter 2: Coffee Break, when you can switch characters. Work out at a fitness club with both characters together (hold Right + Triangle to call your partner) — while one trains, the other completes training too. Filter for fitness clubs on Map > Activities.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile (view the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list). Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a little demon face appears whenever an action counts. Professional (stealthy robberies, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable actions all count. You will get most of them passively through robberies and the 100% checklist; if you still need more, farm it by running over civilians and cops — but note cops shoot on sight at Psycho or Irredeemable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED 20 Nov 2026: in the Prologue, Lucia robs a Payday Loans store — and second time's the charm means going back. After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer, go to the Payday Loans in Vice City > Little Cuba as Lucia ALONE, without Jason. Aim at the teller, take out the security, break through the door and empty the 3 cash drawers, then run away ON FOOT — driving away does not count. The pop is delayed: escape the police search area and run far enough.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED 20 Nov 2026: the UFO easter egg. Go SOLO to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is there you can trigger the UFO; if not, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods by the blinking car and you will see the UFO (bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy. The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED 20 Nov 2026: on any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds — a melee drive-by. Crowded spots like Vice City streets or Ocean Beach give you the targets; keep moving and keep kicking.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3: Credit Check first — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). You need $250,000 in total, across all robberies. Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery once unlocked (after Chapter 4: That's Where The Money Is…).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Fastest on the most expensive things: guns, car mods and tattoos. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total). They unlock after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone — buy them through the app. (4 more garages come from the story and don't count.) Robberies in Chapters 3-4 are the fastest money.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles with the Scooter Bros app (installed after Chapter 2: Moses). You need enough garage parking first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register Standard Tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money — use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
